comparison_to_prior_snapshot.price_response: price recovered/held above dPOC despite materially lower CVD

interpretation: Aggressive selling increased materially as CVD fell, but price recovered and reclaimed dPOC while OI remained flat-to-lower. This is stronger long-side evidence than CVD direction alone because bearish flow is failing to move price lower. It suggests passive/spot absorption or short-side exhaustion. The edge is conditional on acceptance above dPOC; a failed reclaim would invalidate the bullish read.

entry_logic.invalidation: acceptance back below dPOC with CVD continuing lower, especially if OI turns upward
entry_logic.size_guidance: small starter only before retest confirmation; scale only after price confirms structure

lesson: Price response dominates raw flow. Price UP/HOLD + CVD DOWN materially + OI FLAT/DOWN at a reclaimed value level is a bullish absorption candidate; the trade is the structural acceptance, not the divergence by itself.
